<thought>To propose a one‑step retrosynthesis for 4,4'-dimethoxystilbene (SMILES C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2) using the Peterson reaction, I will search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic transformation that breaks an alkene and forms a ketone and a trimethylsilyl group. This matches the forward Peterson reaction where an alkene is formed from a ketone and a trimethylsilyl carbanion.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["alkene"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["ketone", "trimethylsilyl"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
